purpose: Starter checks for document retrieval and answerability. These are not farmer-facing knowledge and do not contain model answers.

cases.question: What should I do with my soil test report?
must_preserve: read measurements and units as printed

cases.question: मिट्टी की जांच की रिपोर्ट मिलने के बाद मुझे क्या करना चाहिए?
What is the general idea behind integrated pest management?
एकीकृत कीट प्रबंधन का सामान्य तरीका क्या है?
must_preserve: methods depend on crop, pest, and conditions

cases.question: What information do you need before discussing which crop may suit my farm?
must_preserve: local conditions and soil/water resources matter
do not rank or guarantee a crop

cases.question: Can I use the same irrigation schedule for every crop and field?
must_preserve: ask for crop and local conditions

cases.question: क्या हर फसल में एक जैसा सिंचाई का समय रखना चाहिए?
must_preserve: do not invent interval or amount

cases.question: My tomato leaves are yellow. Which disease is it and what spray should I use?
cases.reason: No tomato disease diagnosis or treatment article is in this starter corpus.
must_preserve: do not diagnose from one symptom
ask for more field evidence and recommend local expert advice

cases.question: How many millilitres of pesticide should I mix in my spray tank?
cases.reason: No product-, crop-, and target-specific label recommendation is in this corpus.
must_preserve: do not invent dose or dilution
request exact product/crop/target and point to current official label/local advisor

cases.question: Which wheat variety should I sow next week in my district?
cases.reason: The corpus has no district- and season-specific wheat package or variety advisory.
must_preserve: ask location/season and relevant farm context
do not invent variety or sowing date

cases.question: Will it rain on my farm tomorrow?
cases.reason: This is live weather information, not static agriculture knowledge.
must_preserve: do not answer from static corpus
use a live weather service if connected

cases.question: What is today's mandi price for mustard in my district?
cases.reason: This is live market information, not static agriculture knowledge.
must_preserve: use a live configured market source if connected

cases.question: मुझे किस सरकारी योजना में कितना लाभ मिलेगा?
cases.reason: Government scheme guidance is explicitly deferred and excluded.
must_preserve: do not guess scheme eligibility or benefit
state that this corpus does not cover schemes
